name: Replit
tagline: Browser-based coding and app building with AI
description: Replit is an online coding environment with an AI agent for building and deploying apps. Its pricing page lists Core, Pro and Enterprise plans.
features: Chat and agent with 'Free Mode' usage
Collaboration and database rollback on Pro
strengths: Core includes $20 towards more powerful models
Pro includes $100 in credits and 28-day database rollback
limitations: The page we read did not show a separate free plan; 'Free Mode' limits appear under Core
Several Pro price figures appeared without labels

plans.name: Core
highlights: Up to 30 hours of chat on Free Mode
Up to 60 projects on Free Mode
plans.note: $20 billed monthly, or $18 a month billed annually. Includes $20 towards more powerful models.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $100 billed monthly, or $90 a month billed annually. Includes $100 towards the most powerful models. Larger credit tiers at $215, $425, $825 and $2,000 a month are offered.

pricing.regional: Prices subject to tax depending on your location. Currency shown as '$' without a code.
notes: A free plan is not stated as a separate plan on the page we read.

verification.notes: Product active. Page has Monthly / Yearly (up to 10% off) view: Core $20/month or $18/month billed annually; Pro $100/month or $90/month billed annually (credit tiers at $215, $425, $825 and $2,000 a month are offered for larger Pro usage); Enterprise custom. Taxes extra. The Core and Pro monthly prices are now confirmed by the struck-through figures.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Describe an app and let an agent build and publish it

capabilities.title: Turn an idea into an app
capabilities.text: Describe a project and the Agent writes the code, evolves it and publishes it.

capabilities.title: Ask in chat
capabilities.text: Replit chat is a conversational way to request what you need.

capabilities.title: Tweak the design visually
capabilities.text: The Infinite Canvas lets you explore and adjust designs, then apply them to your app.

capabilities.title: Build many kinds of project
capabilities.text: Build types include website, mobile, design, slides, animation, data visualisation, 3D game, document and spreadsheet.

featureCards.name: Agent
featureCards.text: Builds, runs and publishes what you describe.

featureCards.name: Free Mode
featureCards.text: Brainstorm and create at no cost, with limits on chat hours and projects by plan.

featureCards.name: Intelligent Model Routing
featureCards.text: Selects the best model for each task.

featureCards.name: Full-stack infrastructure
featureCards.text: Built-in authentication, database, hosting and monitoring.

featureCards.name: 100+ integrations
featureCards.text: Including OpenAI, Stripe and Google Workspace.

featureCards.name: Enterprise controls
featureCards.text: SSO and SAML, SOC 2, admin controls and audit logs on the Enterprise plan.
